top.line: hub.agenticcells.site: every agentic site in a repository and an sgit vault, with a page to find and copy it.
top.para: Listed by consent; the first example is a made-up Algarve orange grower.

in-short.line: Why a hub, two places, a page per site, vaults as distribution, consent, the first example.

why.line: Many small sites, each a template: they need a home where they can be found and copied.
why.para: Like a code host, for agentic sites.

two-places.line: A public repository and an identical sgit vault, pushed on every release.
two-places.para: Our first real integration with sgit, run in parallel.

pages.line: A page per site: owner, team, live address, repository, vault, licence, versions.
pages.para: No database: hub.json files and a registry.

consent.line: Nothing listed without consent; promotion is a benefit.
consent.para: A site leaves the day its owner asks.

team.line: A separate agentic team builds the hub.
team.para: First listings: agenticcells.com, the orange grower, two demo vaults.

oranges.line: A made-up Algarve orange grower selling wholesale with delivery, played by me.
oranges.para: Choose, see the price of oranges and delivery, send a request; no payments.

limits.line: A proposal, vault serving under test, and a made-up example.

sources.line: My own thinking and the day's briefs.
